method: Downloaded public CRX and parsed manifest and JavaScript statically. Did not install or execute the extension, access a personal browser profile, or read any personal cookies.

dynamicQueryParams.language: UI language normalized to primary language subtag
dynamicQueryParams.device_id: Native device_id if applicable; otherwise launch web_id when launch config has ttwid, else "0"
dynamicQueryParams.tea_uuid: Local uuid; if absent, two randomly generated 9-digit integers concatenated and persisted locally
dynamicQueryParams.web_id: teaWebId ?? tea_uuid ?? launch webId ?? "0"; tea_uuid is generated when absent

bodyFields.raw_text: Array of source text strings, not one string
bodyFields.target_lang: Target language code from chosen language
bodyFields.translate_service: String enum: "0" HUOSHAN, "1" LLM / Doubao, "2" GOOGLE, "3" MICROSOFT
bodyFields.scene: Numeric enum: 1 PageTranslate, 2 AIReader, 3 ChooseWordsTranslate; other feature scenes also exist

bodyNotes: Page translation defaults translate_service to LLM, and sends only raw_text, target_lang, translate_service, scene in the inspected caller. No frontend_source field in this caller or generated SDK method.
The port SSE transport merges base query params, JSON-serializes the body, and explicitly appends Agw-Js-Conv: str. Fetch-event-source adds Accept: text/event-stream when missing.
This is a protocol snapshot from version 1.38.0, not a service stability or usage-quota guarantee.

bootstrap.bodyEncoding: JSON.stringify despite declared form-urlencoded content type
notes: check status_code 0 means no refresh; otherwise register and validate HTTP OK plus status_code 0.
Official code uses normal fetch; cookie storage / Set-Cookie handling is left to browser. This report contains no cookie values.
The extension separately POSTs /alice/user/launch and stores config.ttwid, config.web_id, and country even when authInfo.isAuthenticated is false.

The inspected code provides a first-party visitor initialization path without a user password or API key. Its static presence alone does not establish anonymous translation success; the independent live request report supplies that evidence.

loginGateBoundary.defaultState: authInfo.isAuthenticated false; limiting maps and sets initially empty
notes: The UI listens for fetch-stream-proxy-unAuthorized, chooses page_translate for stream_article_translate, and opens a login entry / emits check-login-fail after an unauthorized response unless preventDefaultAuthAction is set.
Action limits are conditional on server-recorded limited actions or a configured local upper limit; authenticated users bypass this UI restriction.
The article-translation caller does not contain an unconditional login precheck in the inspected request path. SHARK_BLOCKED only triggers service-unavailable feedback.

The official extension has cookies permission and uses a normal browser fetch. These facts do not imply that all requests from an already logged-in official installation omit account cookies. FluentRead must isolate its own anonymous credentials instead.
